The diagram represents a $ 7$-foot-by-$ 7$-foot floor that is tiled with $ 1$-square-foot black tiles and white tiles. Notice that the corners have white tiles. If a $ 15$-foot-by-$ 15$-foot floor is to be tiled in the same manner, how many white tiles will be needed?

method.method_draft: First describe the image: the 7-by-7 floor can be viewed as white square islands separated by one-tile-wide black horizontal and vertical stripes; equivalently, black tiles fill every even-numbered row and every even-numbered column, while white tiles remain only where both row and column are odd.
